  • Method Details

    • findAllSimulatedInstruments

      @Query(value="SELECT i.instrument_id, i.ticker, i.name, i.asset_class, i.currency, i.location,\n p.initial_price, p.drift, p.volatility, p.market_correlation, p.spread_bps,\n p.shares_outstanding, p.avg_daily_volume, p.earnings_per_share, p.dividend_per_share\nFROM instruments i\nJOIN instrument_market_params p ON p.instrument_id = i.instrument_id\nORDER BY i.instrument_id\n", nativeQuery=true) List<Object[]> findAllSimulatedInstruments()
      Loads every simulated instrument: identity columns from instruments joined with its simulation settings.

      A native query is used so the market feature does not import the orders feature's Instrument entity (keeping feature dependencies acyclic, see AGENTS.md). Columns are returned positionally; see MarketPersistenceService#toMarketInstrument for the mapping. Instruments without a params row are not simulated and therefore have no quote.
